'''Brian Carter''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Tulsa Grand Slam]] on 29 April 2000 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down]], according to Matt Lush's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d656">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-02-tulsa-grand-slam-29-aprild656/ tulsa-grand-slam-29-april], DeckTech (Matt "Old Skooler" Lush, 2 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-02-tulsa-grand-slam-29-aprild656/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
